observations: A vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden table with metal legs.
The machine is black with gold/yellow decorative patterns and text.
The brand name 'TWO LION' is visible on the head of the machine in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2.
The machine has a handwheel on the right, a presser foot, and a needle assembly.
The table has a reddish-brown top with visible wear and scratches.
There is a foot pedal mechanism under the table with a metal grate and 'TWO LION' branding.
The machine appears to be a manual or treadle model, not electric.
The background shows a window with metal bars and a yellow wall.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'IFE IFE' are overlaid on all photos.

claims.evidence: No video or photo shows the machine in operation. The photos only show the static condition.

risks.risk: The machine may not work or may have mechanical issues such as broken gears, loose parts, or worn-out components.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine being operated with the handwheel turning and the needle moving up and down.

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden damage or rust inside the mechanism not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal mechanism, including the bobbin case, gears, and tension assembly.

risks.risk: The table or stand may be unstable or have structural damage.
risks.proof: Photos showing the underside of the table and legs, including joints and connections.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, showing the handwheel turning and needle moving.
Close-up photos of the internal mechanism (bobbin, gears, tension assembly).
Photos of the underside of the table and legs to check for structural integrity.
response.reason: The brand 'TWO LION' is clearly visible, but the claim that it 'works perfectly' cannot be verified from static photos. Mechanical functionality and hidden damage are critical risks that require video and close-up photos to assess. Without proof of operation, the item must be priced as not working, and structural integrity is also unverified.
